status: policy-baseline-only; software and physical protections not fully verified

protection_domains.cybersecurity: least privilege, authenticated owner commands, secure updates, local privacy, network isolation, tamper and replay resistance
protection_domains.water_environment: rain and splash only as future test cases, puddle and water-entry exclusion, humidity, condensation, dust, mud, corrosion and temperature; ingress rating not established
protection_domains.fire_heat_power: battery BMS, charging safety, thermal monitoring, overcurrent and short-circuit protection, protected wiring and independently engineered power isolation
protection_domains.communications: network and GPS loss or spoofing, sensor disconnection, stale or replayed commands, clock faults and local safe behavior
protection_domains.ai_data: false or missed detections, uncertain localization, out-of-distribution terrain, sensor conflict, privacy and data retention
protection_domains.mechanical: quadruped balance and falls, joint and actuator faults, pinch and crush points, collision, payload shift, emergency stop and manual recovery
protection_domains.human_mission: owner supervision, child and pet separation, bystander safety, excluded areas, mission abort, safe stop, carry/lift recovery and privacy zones

project_specific_hazards: loss of balance, trip, fall or tip-over
stairs, ledges, thresholds, slopes and unknown terrain
collision or contact with people, children and pets
joint pinch, crush, shear, entanglement and actuator jam
battery damage, unsafe charging, overheating and fire
rain, splash, puddles, dust, humidity, condensation and corrosion
localization, GPS, sensor or communication loss and spoofing
privacy exposure from camera, audio and location data
unsafe restart or manual recovery after a fault
